findings.detail: The schedule reconciles gross investments to net investments by subtracting unfunded loan commitments; extracted cost should conserve to net cost 314,145,189 rather than the gross loan/commitment population.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation resolves the flag. Filing totals show Total Investments cost 314,145,189 and fair value 314,170,238, and the schedule subtotal explicitly reconciles gross Total investments cost 419,789,179 to Net investments cost 314,145,189 by subtracting unfunded loan commitments of 105,643,990. The observed extracted cost sum 402,991,550 overshoots the net cost anchor and does not respect the row-disposition structure, so the conservation failure is a real data error rather than a bad anchor.
